title: game/phrases.json
description: The phrase sheet: the phrases the learner says or hears, with their support card and recordings. content/PHRASES.md is the source of truth (D-game-10); PhraseSheetTests keeps the two in step. Loaded by PhraseSheet (Vocaterra.Game.Core). Each row's meaning and card are the locale's (phrase.<id>.meaning, .card, .explain) since C03.

id.description: A stable id (pedir-agua); saves and lessons name it.

says.description: Who says it: the learner (says), an NPC (hears), both, or does: an instruction an NPC gives while a procedure is done (W05; no intent, no prompt, no learner error).

spanish.description: The phrase in the target language.

intent.description: The core intent the phrase expresses, or null for a phrase only heard or instructed (does).

prompt.description: The bundle prompt the phrase belongs to; null for an instruction (does), which no prompt asks for.

variants.description: Other spellings the learner may say for the same row.

audioLineIds.description: The speech lines that say the phrase.

reviewLine.description: The dialogue line the guide's review asks the phrase with when the bundle has no review pool for it (C08).
